title: Shiota
source:
'''Shiota''' (written: 塩田 or 潮田) is a Japanese surname. Notable people with the surname include:

*{{Nihongo|[[Akihiko Shiota]]|塩田 明彦||born 1961}}, Japanese film director and screenwriter
*{{Nihongo|[[Chiharu Shiota]]|塩田 千春||born 1972}}, Japanese artist
*{{Nihongo|[[Hitoshi Shiota]]|塩田 仁史||born 1981}}, Japanese footballer
*{{Nihongo|[[Reiko Shiota]]|潮田 玲子||born 1983}}, Japanese baseball player
*{{Nihongo|[[Sayo Shiota]]|塩田 沙代||born 1989}}, Japanese handball player
*{{Nihongo|[[Takahiro Shiota]]|塩田 隆比呂}}, Japanese mathematician
*{{Nihongo|[[Takeo Shiota]]|塩田 武雄||1881–1943}}, Japanese-American landscape architect

==Fictional characters==
*{{Nihongo|[[List of Assassination Classroom characters#Main characters|Nagisa Shiota]]|潮田 渚}}, a character in the ''[[Assassination Classroom]]'' anime and manga

*[[Shiota, Saga]], a former town in Saga Prefecture, Japan
